address: 472-476 Meiling Road, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, China Mainland
bio: Famous for its beef dishes, this shop was named after the owner, whose moniker means wryneck. His signature braised beef rib exudes curry flavour and a hint of Chinese herbs. The fork-tender meat goes well with the buttery seasoned rice. Another highlight is the double-boiled oxtail – the meat is slow cooked until gelatinous; infused with Indian mulberry root, the broth tastes mildly sweet. Certain items tend to sell out fast, so come early....
